description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a worker thread pool system, including the IWorkerPool interface, WorkerPool implementation, and a DecoupledJob class for asynchronous job handling within the WPEFramework core namespace.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread pool, providing methods for submitting, scheduling, rescheduling, revoking jobs, and obtaining pool metadata.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of the IWorkerPool interface managing a thread pool with scheduling and revocation capabilities.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::DecoupledJob
classes.description: A class representing a decoupled, asynchronously dispatched job using std::function.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::IWorkerPool::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the worker pool.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::IWorkerPool::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a specific job from the pool.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool for execution.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to be executed at a specific time.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job to a new time.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool::Snapshot
methods.description: Returns current metadata about the worker pool.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::DecoupledJob::Submit
methods.description: Submits a lambda or function as a job for asynchronous execution.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Core::DecoupledJob::Revoke
methods.description: Revoke the scheduled or running job.
